verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Git Sync keeps project data in the user's repository rather than vendor-hosted storage (insomnia-docs-22, insomnia-docs-44). Projects can also be converted to Local Vault (insomnia-docs-32), and the product is Apache-2.0 open source (insomnia-gh-3), which supports leaving with your data. The import/export page lists open formats such as Insomnia YAML v5, Postman v2.x, HAR and OpenAPI, but the snippets document these as import formats, so a full-account export in open formats is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exporting all workspaces, environments and collections in open formats, a bulk or account-wide export path, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a clean exit.
